mapper.select: SELECT s.store_name AS storeName, i.ingredient_name AS ingredientName, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(od.current_quantity) FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.store_id = s.store_id AND od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id AND od.current_quantity > 0 AND od.order_status = '승인' AND od.store_at IS NOT NULL ), 0) AS currentQuantity, i.order_unit AS orderUnit, i.capacity AS capacity, i.capacity_unit AS capacityUnit, i.storage_type AS storageType, i.management_method AS managementMethod, i.expiration_period AS expirationPeriod, i.consumption_period AS consumptionPeriod, i.summer_consumption_period AS summerConsumptionPeriod FROM stores s CROSS JOIN ingredients i WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND i.ingredient_id = #{ingredientId}

SELECT od.manufacture_at AS manufactureAt, DATE_ADD(od.manufacture_at, INTERVAL i.expiration_period DAY) AS expirationDate, od.store_at AS storeAt, od.order_quantity AS orderQuantity, i.order_unit AS orderUnit FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND od.ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} AND od.order_status = '승인' AND od.store_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT iu.consumption_at AS consumptionAt, iu.management_start_at AS managementStartAt, DATE(DATE_ADD(od.manufacture_at, INTERVAL i.expiration_period DAY)) AS expirationAt, od.manufacture_at AS manufacture_at, od.store_at AS storeAt, od.order_quantity AS orderQuantity, i.order_unit AS orderUnit, iu.usage_quantity AS usageQuantity FROM inventory_usages iu JOIN order_details od ON iu.order_detail_id = od.order_detail_id JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND od.ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} ORDER BY iu.management_start_at DESC;

SELECT order_detail_id AS orderDetailId, order_quantity AS orderQuantity, supply_price AS supplyPrice, manufacture_at AS manufactureAt, store_at AS storeAt, app_at AS appAt, order_status AS orderStatus, order_price AS orderPrice, reject_reason AS rejectReason, current_quantity AS currentQuantity, order_id AS orderId, ingredient_id AS ingredientId FROM order_details WHERE order_detail_id = #{orderDetailId} AND order_status = '승인'
